# This is how we experienced the commemoration of EAFIT's 60th anniversary

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Institutional Information EAFIT University](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional)
- [History of EAFIT](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia)
- 60 Years

[We shared meaningful moments](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/60-anos/conmemoracion)

[We proposed a Declaration for Hope](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/60-anos/declaracion-esperanza)

[We renew our founding principles](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/60-anos/ratificacion-renovacion)

###### Thank you for continuing to inspire, create, and transform!

![](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/JpcoVNgNx_o/maxresdefault.jpg)

[Let's continue building this collective dream of a university together.](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/un-mensaje-del-rector-para-continuar-la-experiencia-universitaria)

###### A conversation with the future

Crossing the threshold, pressing the entry button, discovering who stands on the opposite side of the door, witnessing the transition between an era that demanded change and one in which those changes raise new questions, new challenges. On the other side of the door, after pressing the button, we are greeted by a singular word in which we, as inhabitants of this stage of history, are admitted in the plural. And of course, it is the future that lies behind the knock, the uncertainty of what may be unknown, that which generates as many questions as answers and which today, after 60 years of journey, challenges the current generation of EAFIT students to increase the pace of progress and take each step with firmness, with the conviction that the future—our future—awaits us beyond this door.

[Read the full conversation](https://www.eafit.edu.co/historia/decada-1960/presentacion)

[![Cover Image The Eafitense 118](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/294df6d1-7e8b-4b36-bd7a-82a009fd79e8/web/revista-eleafitense-118.jpg)](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/60)

![](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/60)

###### A new edition of El Eafitense magazine revisited EAFIT's history during its first 60 years and gathered visions for the future.

[Read magazine](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/60#)

###### Learn about EAFIT's main contributions to society over these six decades.

###### The milestones that speak of EAFIT and its decisive role in the construction of the region and the country

[1960s](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/decada-1960) [1970s](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/decada-de-1970) [1980s](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/decada-1980) [1990s](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/decada-1990) [2000s](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historias/decada-2000) [2010s](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/decada-2010)

###### Towards a new decade:   2020-2030

The Stanford curve suggests that, by 2020, humanity will go from doubling its knowledge stock every five years to every 23 hours. This is just one of the many indicators that demonstrate how, driven by new information and communication technologies and within the context of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, society is taking a historic leap into the new decade. And, of course, higher education institutions will be fundamental in responding to this transformation.

[Discover this complete vision](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/historia/futuro)
